packetIssues.issue: The PDF asks which change increases the half-life of a first-order reaction, but prints answer 3 (increasing the rate constant). For a first-order reaction t₁/₂ = ln(2)/k, so increasing k decreases the half-life; changing starting concentration has no effect. This is a source-answer error and has not been silently changed.
